blocks.text: A cooperative described its new queue system as “a window, not a verdict.” The display shows how many orders await work, but not their complexity. After a difficult repair occupied the shop for two days, some members wanted the display removed because its count had stayed low. The manager kept it, added a note that a low count did not promise quick completion, and began recording job types separately. She declined to replace the count with a single promised date until she could compare the new records with actual completion times.
